verdict: Paid ads paused since Sep 17; relaunch blocked on open build items.
narrative: Both Meta and Google Ads have been paused since September 17, bringing paid lead flow to zero for the last 8 days of this period. Before the pause, Meta was delivering leads at roughly $16.18 per lead — the only paid channel producing results, as Google Ads spent $384.52 over the 28-day window with no leads attributed. Ads are not relaunching until several overdue build items are completed — including landing pages, creative assets, and a full end-to-end system test — so that when spend resumes, every path from ad to payment is verified and working. Once those items are signed off, both channels relaunch with the infrastructure in place to properly track and convert leads; that work is in progress now and targeted for completion by September 30.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from Meta before the pause on Sep 17
cost per lead on Meta over the last 28 days
spent on Google Ads this period with zero leads attributed — that channel was already being addressed before the pause

watch_item.issue: Both paid channels are dark and lead flow is at zero.
watch_item.fix: Relaunch is gated on completing landing pages, creative assets, and a full-stack test — all targeted for closure by September 30, after which paid campaigns resume.
